title: With Spain’s far right on the cusp of power, can women bail Sanchez out once again?
summary: Spanish women’s refusal to surrender hard-won rights helped Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez clinch an unlikely victory in a snap election three years ago. As he gambles with another early vote on Sunday, his hopes of defying the odds rest on women again rallying to block the far right from governing Spain for the first time since Francisco Franco’s d…
